name: Henan Zhongyuan Expressway Company Limited
summary: Henan Zhongyuan Expressway Company Limited engages in investment, construction, operation, and management of expressways in China. It operates through Highway Toll Road and Bridge Division; Real Estate Development Division; Investment Business Division; and Others segments. The company operates Airport Expressway, the Zhengzhou-Zhumadian section of the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway, the Zhengzhou-Yaoshan section of the Zhengluan-Luan Expressway, Zhengzhou-Minquan Expressway, Shangqiu-Dengfeng Expressway, and Yongcheng section of Dezhou-Shangqiu Expressway.
